**Only the media worth studying.**

Clips used to save every icon on the page. On a real library that meant arrows, chevrons, menu glyphs and GitHub, X and Discord marks: 149 of the 243 SVGs saved for a 20-site collection. 0.9.3 saves the site's own logo and what its main content shows, and summarizes the rest in one line per kind.

**Saved:** the logo (up to 3 versions), illustrations and diagrams, feature-size icons drawn in the content, images, video, Lottie and Rive files, the biggest site icon, and the share image.

**Left out on purpose, and described instead:**
- **UI icons** (inside links and buttons, in the nav, or under 32px): the icon-system line still gives their grid, stroke, caps and ink, measured over all of them.
- **Social and integration icons.**
- **Partner logos**, described once as a logo wall: how many, the size, ink, filter and opacity.
- **Everything else in the nav, footer, sidebars, dialogs and cookie layers.**
- **Images shown 48px or smaller**, and images the page loaded but never placed when they're under 20 KB.

### Updating

`git pull`, click ↻ on Artspo in `chrome://extensions`, then **↻ Re-inspect all** in the popup. Re-inspecting rewrites each clip's `assets/` with the new selection, but files from the earlier run stay in the folder until you delete them.

### Files

- `artspo-0.9.3.zip`: the whole repo (extension, skill, MCP server, docs). Use this one.
- `artspo-extension-0.9.3.zip`: just the `extension/` folder, the Chrome Web Store upload.

Requires Chrome 118+ on macOS (Linux works; Windows isn't supported). [5-minute tutorial](https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md) · [artbook.dev](https://artbook.dev/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=artspo)
